landing.title: A game to meet someone.
landing.sub: See how you would look together in three moments of life: vacation, wedding and old age. If you both say yes, the conversation opens.
landing.safe2: Nothing is generated without your approval.
landing.safe3: Images are sample illustrations, watermarked and not downloadable.
landing.safe4: You can delete your photos and data whenever you want.
